facts.fact: The Malawi Voice Data Commons, built by NYU and Mozilla with Malawian universities, fine-tunes OpenAI's Whisper model on newly collected Chichewa data and runs local servers for real-time keyword detection and transcription of emergency reports, cutting response times from 72 to 6 hours, per Portulans Institute.

systems.platform: Whisper fine-tuned on Chichewa; local servers; NYU Greene HPC for off-peak analysis
systems.owner: NYU and Mozilla, moving to Malawian universities by 2027

facts.fact: Portulans Institute cites Malawi's 2018 census data for adult literacy limits (35%) and lack of regular internet access (73%).
